errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категории на отговори, дефинирани като: "Да, напълно преценя", "Не мога да преценя", "Не, изобщо; По-скоро не" и "(blank)".
errors.evidence: The list of categories is incorrect. It misquotes the first category "Да, напълно." as "Да, напълно преценя". It incorrectly combines two separate categories, "Не, изобщо;" and "По-скоро не;", into a single entry. It also completely omits the category "По-скоро да;" which corresponds to the tallest bar.
The description states that the number of responses ranges from 12 to 43. However, the lowest value shown on a bar is 1, not 12.

The description does not properly describe the vertical axis. It fails to mention that the axis represents the count of responses, its numerical range is from 0 to 50, and its major tick marks are at intervals of 5. The prompt explicitly requires a description of the value axis.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете за отговорите "Да, напълно преценя" и "Не, изобщо; По-скоро не" са най-високи, достигайки 43 и 35 респективно.
errors.evidence: This statement is entirely incorrect. The tallest bar, with a value of 43, corresponds to the category "По-скоро да;", not "Да, напълно преценя" (which has a value of 12). Furthermore, the value 35 does not exist on the chart for any category.

errors.text_span: Стойностите са етикетирани с числа, като Scalе е линейна, като числата се появяват на интервали от 5 и са подредени във възходящ ред.
errors.evidence: This sentence is awkwardly phrased and confusingly mixes a description of the axis scale with the data values. It also uses the English word "Scale" instead of a Bulgarian equivalent.
